# pycc

> pycc is a strict ahead-of-time compiler for typed, standard Python 3.14. Its
> design target is a standalone native binary produced through Rust and LLVM.

Project status: pre-alpha. The first end-to-end compiler slice exists; broad
language coverage and production readiness are roadmap work.

Canonical website: https://rotnov.github.io/pycc/
Source repository: https://github.com/rotnov/pycc
Specification index: https://github.com/rotnov/pycc/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md
Language standards matrix: https://github.com/rotnov/pycc/blob/main/docs/PYTHON_STANDARDS.md
Roadmap: https://github.com/rotnov/pycc/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md
License: MIT
